text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":7,"unit":"plants","kind":"count","span":"7 fewer plants"},{"id":"q2","value":60,"unit":"%","kind":"count","span":"60% more plants"},{"id":"q3","value":10,"unit":"plants","kind":"count","span":"Frederick has 10"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q2"],"out":"s1","note":"convert 60% to a fraction by dividing by 100"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"60% of Frederick's plant count, the extra amount"},{"op":"add","args":["q3","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"Toni's plants = Frederick's plants plus the 60% extra"},{"op":"sub","args":["s3","q1"],"out":"s4","note":"Shondra's plants = Toni's plants minus 7"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"how many plants Shondra has"},"dismissed":[]}
